task.description: Implement ADP-04 in backend code and migrations following src/design/adp-04-user-tenant-binding.md. Add users.tenant_id UUID NOT NULL with default tenant backfill semantics, enforce single-tenant user membership invariants in identity/group operations, and update identity repository/service APIs so tenant context is explicit and consistently applied for reads/writes. Preserve backward compatibility for pre-existing users bound to default tenant and avoid cross-tenant leakage in identity/group paths. Update or add unit/integration tests required for ADP-04 coverage. Validate with zig build, zig build test, zig build migrate, and ensure no error-set propagation issues remain.
acceptance_criteria: Backend implementation satisfies ADP-04 acceptance criteria and aligns with design artifact
Users are tenant-bound with default-tenant compatibility for existing rows
Identity/group operations enforce same-tenant constraints and block cross-tenant access
zig build, zig build test, and zig build migrate all exit 0
zig build produces no error-set mismatch output

result.summary: Implemented ADP-04 tenant-bound identity behavior: added users/groups tenant binding migration, made identity registry/service APIs tenant-explicit for read/write paths, and enforced same-tenant constraints in group membership and claim checks to prevent cross-tenant leakage. Added ADP-04 integration coverage and wired it into integration main test imports. Validation outcomes: zig build = PASS, zig build test = PASS, zig build migrate = PASS (with BPM_DB_URL set to local test DB), zig build error-set check (zig build 2>&1 | Select-String -Pattern "error set") = PASS with no output.
